name: hero-gradient
description: Full-width hero section with gradient background, headline, subheadline, and CTA button

ai.whenToUse: Use as the primary above-fold hero section on landing pages. Best for marketing sites, SaaS landing pages, and product pages that need a strong visual first impression with a gradient background.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for internal dashboard pages, documentation sites, or pages where a simpler text-only hero would be more appropriate. Avoid stacking multiple hero blocks.

subheadline.example: The CLI-first framework for Astro + Cloudflare that lets you ship in minutes, not months.

badge.description: Optional small badge text above the headline (e.g. 'New', 'Beta')
